technique_name: Craft a story from the following three words: Moon, Whale, Balloon
description: There was once a little boy who loved the night sky. He would often lay out on a blanket, gazing up at the stars, the full moon and the bright constellations above him. One night, he saw something extra special—a giant whale swimming across the sky, with beautiful balloons tied to its tail.
